module_lock_provenance: The 13-module registry was prespecified and analysis-locked before the authoritative run. No immutable external preregistration timestamp exists.
preregistered_key_compatibility_note: Historical filenames and JSON keys containing 'preregistered' are retained only for compatibility and do not assert external preregistration.
module_multiple_testing: BH is conservatively computed with n=13 configured modules, including modules unevaluable at minsize=10.
preregistered_module_result: No evaluable primary module reaches BH q<=0.10 (12 evaluable; 13 configured). Nominal rotation p-values are not treated as statistically supported module enrichment.
transcriptomic_nomination_conclusion: Transcriptomics does not validate a specific rescue candidate. Nominal module p-values, gene-direction stability, exploratory contrasts, and orthology cannot override this branch.
leave_one_batch_out_decision_set_provena: Post-primary implementation amendment dated 2026-08-26; fixed before module-level leave-one-batch sensitivity. The original analysis lock covers all 13 modules, not this subset; no immutable external preregistration timestamp exists.

leave_one_batch_out_full_null_to_support.interpretation: Fragile leave-one-batch sensitivity only; it cannot override the full-analysis null.

leave_one_batch_out_fit_warning_note: Numerical fit warnings occurred and are retained verbatim by omitted batch in sensitivity/leave_one_batch_out_summary.tsv; no values were forced.
leave_one_batch_out_interpretation: The diagnostic downgrade branch uses a post-primary implementation-amendment subset fixed before module leave-one-batch analysis; it is not part of the original 13-module analysis lock. Gene-level Spearman is diagnostic only. Stability does not supply statistical support for mitochondrial, proteostasis, or any other module enrichment. When the full module result is null, a reversal is descriptive instability evidence, not a second inferential rejection or statistically meaningful module evidence.

normalized_direction_gate_sensitivity.interpretation: Normalized-direction sensitivity does not change any primary candidate call.

orthology_policy_sensitivity.interpretation: Global signed scores are stable across policies, but top human-gene prioritization is mapping-dependent; no top-gene nominee is treated as robust without dual-policy review.

annotation_policy_direction_flips.interpretation: Descriptive annotation-policy direction instability; both policies are null at BH q<=0.10.

authoritative_module_multiplicity_column: module_qvalue (BH with n=13 configured modules). roastgsa_adj_pvalue_evaluable_only is retained for transparency and is not used for decisions.
limitations: Six whole-brain libraries from three batch pairs; tissue composition can contribute to observed effects.
SAC-depletion/CIN pathway evidence is not BUB1B-specific.
GSE301548 is perfectly confounded by chronological age and genotype and is exploratory only.
claim_boundary: No clinical or treatment claim is made. Named candidates are prospective preclinical benchmarks only; none is transcriptomically validated or preferred, and none is used to manufacture transcriptomic evidence.
